mapper.select: select m.*, u.real_name as user_name, r.room_name from oa_meeting_apply m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.id left join oa_meeting_room r on m.room_id = r.id order by m.id desc

select m.*, u.real_name as user_name, r.room_name from oa_meeting_apply m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.id left join oa_meeting_room r on m.room_id = r.id where m.user_id = #{userId} order by m.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_meeting_apply(user_id, room_id, subject, content, start_time, end_time, participants, status) values(#{userId}, #{roomId}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{participants}, #{status})
mapper.update: update oa_meeting_apply set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from oa_meeting_apply where room_id = #{roomId} and status in (0, 1) and #{startTime} < end_time and #{endTime} > start_time
